masterData.varietiesIntro: The full variety record — public profile, detector mapping, and reference dimensions used for grading.
masterData.searchPlaceholder: Search name, scientific name, or class
masterData.descriptionPlaceholder: Notes inspectors will see in the catalog
masterData.imageHint: Public URL — paste a hero image link or leave blank for the family-tinted placeholder.
masterData.invalidClass: Detector class must be a whole number.
masterData.invalidLength: Reference length must be a positive number.
masterData.invalidWidth: Reference width must be a positive number.

hyperparams.title: Model hyperparameters
hyperparams.intro: Tune the live + single-shot inference thresholds and live fps for QA. Settings persist across reloads; tap Reset to revert to defaults.
hyperparams.scoreThresholdHint: Drop detections below this score before NMS. Higher = fewer false positives.
hyperparams.iouThresholdHint: JS-side NMS overlap cutoff. YOLO26 (NMS-baked) ignores this.
hyperparams.targetFpsIosHint: Worklet inference rate. 30 fps matches the camera; 60 fps doubles ANE thermal load.
hyperparams.targetFpsAndroidHint: JS-thread bridge cost dominates; keep ≤ 10 fps.
hyperparams.resetBody: All values revert to the shipped defaults.
